constants.bond_source: Marti, Alvarez, Kaufmann and Sigrist (1998), SEI 8(4), 287-298: tau_b0 = 2 f_ct elastic, tau_b1 = f_ct yielded
constants.spacing_source: same source, s_r,max = phi / (4 rho) under the stepped bond, s_rm = lam_s s_r,max, lam_s = 0.67 mid-range of the admissible [0.5, 1.0]
